system.specialAbility:
You belong to the Forge-Blood Dwarf Bloodline.

Forge Resistance. You gain Resistance 2 to fire damage. It becomes Resistance 4 at Expert Origin rank, 6 at Master, and 8 at Legendary. This reduces damage only; it does not make smoke safe to breathe or automatically prevent other effects of heat.
system.description: A bloodline of the Dwarf ancestry. Its Root Talent is granted free by the character-creation choice.
